findings.body: `suggestionDomain` requires both a permitted measure and a permitted dimension. Grants are independently configurable, and an aggregate Ask remains valid for a user with the report action, the governed-financial domain, and Actual permission but no dimension grant. For that user this branch builds an empty `exampleQuestions` array: definitions and small-talk expose no suggestions, while the unsupported fallback emits the generic “ask for an allowed metric by an allowed field” instead of a governed 3F question. Generate an aggregate question such as “Actual for <latest month>” when no permitted dimension is available.
findings.title: Not done: suggestion sources can return no governed 3F questions

findings.body: The new regression tests construct `ChatService` directly with fake dimensions and a fake period resolver; the fallback test bypasses Ask entirely and calls `unsupportedFallbackMessage` directly. Consequently they cannot detect failures in Nest wiring, real warehouse period discovery, HTTP serialization, or rendering/clicking the returned suggestions in Ask. No Playwright test exercises these user-facing suggestion sources through the running API with a real database, as required by the test-audit contract.
findings.title: Not done: Ask suggestions lack required API-and-browser end-to-end coverage

why: Ask's help suggestions still carry MBS question templates (by state, last 30 days, leads, RPush)
